facts.text: Providence College students complete the four-semester Development of Western Civilization Program, which includes three chronological courses and a team-taught fourth-semester colloquium.

sources.title: How DWC Works – The Development of Western Civilization Program at Providence College
sources.quote: The first three semesters of the Development of Western Civilization Program consist of a seminar-style encounter with significant texts from Western and other world civilizations. These three semesters are four credits each and arranged chronologically.

sources.title: How DWC Works – The Development of Western Civilization Program at Providence College
sources.quote: The fourth semester of the Development of Western Civilization Program人士 consists of a team-taught, four-credit colloquium.
